title: Over 2 million people evacuated, 200 flights cancelled: How Japan is bracing for Typhoon Mekkhala
summary: Japan has evacuated over 2 million people amid Typhoon Mekkhala's approach, issuing flood and landslide warnings. Torrential rains have affected parts of Taiwan, shutting down workplaces and schools, with significant rainfall recorded in southern regions.
